title: Prep Drill Log Status Mix
dataSources: Go-bag inventories (`gobag:inventory`), prep drills (`prep:drill`), water rotation logs (`water:rotation`), battery expiration checks (`battery:expiration`), and radio tests (`radio:test`).
app: Go-bag inventory audits, household prep drill logs, water rotation schedules, battery expiration trackers, and emergency radio test results streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prep:drill
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(drill_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the prep drill log feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `drill_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It totals the overall mood of your prep drill log feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
